#RayNeoAir4Pro #smartglasses #XRGlasses
Experience movies like never before with RayNeo Air 4 Pro, a cinematic AR display you can wear anywhere.

This special Batman collaboration edition brings a unique design inspired by Gotham’s legendary hero and his iconic rival Joker.

Unlike many regular AR glasses that rely on SDR 8-bit panels, RayNeo Air 4 Pro supports HDR10 with 10-bit color, delivering stronger contrast, brighter highlights, and deeper blacks. Perfect for watching dark cinematic scenes like those from Batman movies.

Powered by the Pixelworks Vision 4000 processor, it can even use AI to convert standard SDR content into HDR in real time, enhancing the viewing experience instantly.

Highlights in this video:

-RayNeo Air 4 Pro Standard Version
-Batman Collaboration Edition
-HDR vs SDR comparison
-Brightness & glare performance (HueView 2.0)
-Bang & Olufsen co-tuned audio
-2D-to-3D conversion via the RayNeo XR app
